label: L11UG-5HaxD
description: MikroTik L11UG-5HaxD (L11UG-5HaxD) — 1x 1G RJ45, Wi-Fi 5 GHz. ARM 32bit 2-core IPQ-5010.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (18-28 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 15 W.
